hero.headline: Your people ask. Your documents answer.
hero.subheadline: The FAQ Assistant answers repetitive HR and People Ops questions automatically, using your own documents. Every answer cites its source. Run it in the cloud, or entirely on your own server.

logos.name: Fewer repeat questions
logos.quote: People find answers themselves, around the clock, without HR sitting in the middle of every request.

logos.name: Answers from your sources
logos.quote: No invented answers. Every response comes from your policies, handbooks and agreements, and names the document it came from.

logos.name: You stay in control
logos.quote: See what people actually ask, and spot exactly where your documentation has gaps.

items.title: Exact matches and semantic search
items.description: Two search methods in one query. Word-for-word matches rank first and are marked as exact. Below them, the assistant understands paraphrases and synonyms, so "time off" finds your vacation policy even when those words never appear.

items.title: Upload your own documents
items.description: Drag in whole folders at once. TXT and Markdown are indexed instantly, PDF and DOCX are supported too. New documents become searchable in seconds.

items.title: Visual knowledge map
items.description: See at a glance what knowledge lives in the system and how documents relate to each other. Duplicates and orphaned content stand out immediately.

items.title: Every answer cites its source
items.description: Each answer shows the passages it was built from, traceable back to the original document.

users.title: Built for HR and People Ops teams at growing companies.

items.title: A good fit if:
items.description: You have 20–500 employees and HR is a handful of people. Your knowledge is scattered across PDFs and intranet pages. The same questions arrive every day by email, Slack, or someone stopping by your desk.

items.title: Probably not for you if:
items.description: You need a full HR suite with payroll and applicant tracking. The FAQ Assistant does one thing and does it well: answer questions.

items.title: Live in days
items.description: We handle the setup. Not a six-month IT project — a tool that runs next week.

items.question: Where does our data live?
items.answer:
That's your call — there are two options.
A · Cloud: your assistant runs on shared infrastructure, with your documents strictly separated from other customers.
B · Private: you get your own isolated instance. Documents and the language model both run on your server, with no external AI provider.
Either way, your data is never used to train anyone's models.

items.question: Does it make things up?
items.answer: The assistant answers only from your documents and shows the source behind every statement. When it can't find a match, it says so instead of guessing.

items.question: How much work is the setup?
items.answer: You provide the documents, we handle the setup. Typical timeline: under two weeks to production use.

items.question: What if it isn't a fit?
items.answer: There's a three-month minimum term — in our experience that's how long an assistant needs to settle into daily use and show measurable relief. After that, cancel any month. No annual contract, no fine print.

items.question: Can we switch or expand later?
items.answer: Yes. Add documents, areas and users whenever you like. Moving from Cloud to your own dedicated instance is possible too, without starting over.

ctaSection.subtext: Transparent pricing, three-month minimum, then cancel any month. No hidden costs.
